name: scroll-animation-repeat
blurb: Gallery with images sliding in from different directions on scroll.
description: A three-column image gallery showing scroll-triggered reveals in varied directions—left, down, and right. Demonstrates ScrollAnimation with multiple direction props.
use_when: A gallery section needing visual variety through directional animation patterns.
avoid_when: When you need to customize animations, directions, or image sources at runtime — this is a fixed demo layout.
a11y: Images have empty alt attributes. Scroll animation is not controllable via keyboard.
